svg.title: NET-03-P — Editable operator-configured dedicated setup
svg.desc: NET-03-PUBLIC-EDIT on the existing 850 by 700 logical desktop canvas. Fixed banner, one service-type cycle row, empty operator Address and Port, separate Invite, two independently scrolling local setup panels, persistent validation and centered Connect/Back. Focus remains on Service type after mode change. No hard-coded endpoint, environment picker, or connection claim.

g.text: The first admitted participant controls the session.
Leaving as host ends the session.
Local players: 1 • Session-only scores • Optional scripts disabled
Enter a valid address and port (1–65535).
ANNOTATIONS: Top-to-bottom reading; left list before right. Mode change keeps row-level focus.
Focused fields scroll text; body lists scroll independently. Keep header, validation and footer fixed.
Operator input only. Invite becomes ******** when entered; focused masks scroll inside the field.
Browser origin retains NET-03-E with no mode target. Dedicated type is absent on macOS/Pi.
